headlines.title: Social Security recipients will receive a 3.6% cost-of-living increase in 2027
headlines.description: Individual retirement benefits will climb an average of about $70 per month, the Social Security Administration said.

headlines.title: Jon Ossoff says he won’t run for president in 2028 during heated Georgia debate
headlines.description: The Democratic incumbent pledged to serve a full term as he and challenger Rep. Mike Collins hit on similar themes as in their first debate last week.

headlines.title: Ukraine accuses SpaceX of restricting Starlink, disrupting military as it reels from intel gaps
headlines.description: Ukraine has accused Elon Musk’s SpaceX of disrupting its military operations by limiting Starlink internet services, as the country reeled from a pair of intense Russian missile attacks that it said came without the usual advance warning from allies.

headlines.title: Texas DA says ICE intentionally hit immigrant with a car and may have withheld evidence
headlines.description: Harris County DA Sean Teare told NBC News his office has collected multiple videos for its own investigation but isn’t getting cooperation from the federal government.

headlines.title: Cornell Bans Frat Parties, Promises New Safeguards for Students
headlines.description: Cornell University is now suspending all fraternity parties and social events for the rest of the school year, and promising tough new measures to safeguard students. It comes as Cornell’s president is acknowledging missteps in the school’s handling of the Jane Doe case and offering a formal apology for the first time. NBC’s Erin McLaughlin reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Pope Leo XIV Found to Have Lung Cancer During Surgery
headlines.description: Well wishes are pouring in for Pope Leo XIV after the 71-year-old pontiff was diagnosed with lung cancer during surgery to remove a nodule on his lung on Tuesday. The Vatican stated that doctors confirmed a diagnosis of pulmonary adenocarcinoma via tissue testing following pre-operative examinations. NBC’s Daniele Hamamdjian reports and medical contributor Dr. John Torres joins TODAY to share his perspective on treatment, recovery and how family history plays a role.

headlines.title: Romance scammers are getting harder to catch. The consequences are costly.
headlines.description: For people looking for love online, a match with a scammer could cost them their life savings.

headlines.title: Trump pardons two vehicle repair shop owners during Alaska rally
headlines.description: During his rally in Alaska, President Trump pardoned Zachary Czuback and Patrick Fleming, co-owners of a vehicle repair shop in Anchorage. Both pleaded guilty in 2022 to violating the Clean Air Act by tampering with federally mandated and monitored devices that tracked vehicles’ diesel emissions.

headlines.title: Netflix to cut about 6% of worldwide staff
headlines.description: Netflix is eliminating about 1,000 jobs in a round of layoffs, according to a source with knowledge of the matter.

headlines.title: Inflation jumps to 3.7% as gas and diesel prices squeeze consumers ahead of the midterms
headlines.description: Prices rose across broad swaths of the economy in September, as high energy costs triggered by the Iran war pushed up costs in many major consumer categories.
